texto: Hi! I'm Emma. What's your name?
Hi, Emma. I'm Jake. Nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you, too. Are you a student?
No, I'm not. I'm a teacher. Are you a student?
Yes, I am. Where are you from?
Mia, this is my friend Tom. Tom, this is Mia.
Hi, Mia. Nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you, too. How are you?
Maria is from Brazil. She is twenty-five years old. She is a teacher. Her friend Tom is from the United States. He is twenty-seven. They are in London today. They are happy.
I live in Boston. Do you live here?
No, I don't. I live in Chicago, but I work here.
I work in a bank. I don't like my job very much.
Excuse me, is this your phone?
No, it isn't. My phone is over there.
Oh, I see. Are these your keys?
That's an umbrella. It isn't mine.

I live in a small apartment in a big city. There is a living room, a kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom. The living room is nice. There is a sofa and a table in the living room. The kitchen is small, but there is a window. There is a lamp next to my bed. I like my apartment.
There are two beds in the bedroom
The phone is on the table
There is a sofa in the living room

My name is Lara. I have a small family. My father is a doctor and my mother is a teacher. I have one brother. His name is Tom. Tom has a dog. The dog's name is Max. My parents' house is big, but my apartment is small. I don't have a car. My brother has a car. I like my family.
Good morning. What would you like?
I'd like a coffee and a sandwich, please.
Would you like some milk in your coffee?
Yes, please. And a glass of water.
No, thanks. Can I have the bill, please?
Can I have the bill, please

Kate is my cousin. She can speak three languages: Portuguese, English and a little Spanish. She can play the guitar very well and she can sing. She can't drive, but she can ride a bike. Her brother Dan can cook and he can swim, but he can't dance. I can't play the guitar, but I can dance.
Excuse me, where is the station?
Go straight and turn left at the traffic light.
No, it's about five minutes on foot. It's next to the bank.
Turn left at the traffic light
Let's meet at half past six in the evening.
Sorry, I can't. I work until seven. What about quarter past seven?

Mark gets up at six every day. He has breakfast at half past six, and then he goes to work. He usually starts work at eight and finishes at five. He has lunch at noon. After work, he goes home and cooks dinner. He never watches TV at night. He reads a book and goes to bed at ten. On the weekend, he gets up late and plays football with his friends.
She gets up at six every day
I never drink coffee at night
What time does she start work
Yes, I love playing football. And you?
I don't like football, but I enjoy swimming.
Do you swim with your brother?
Yes, I swim with him every Saturday.
Great! Can I swim with you and him?

My best friend is Dan. He is 28 years old. He is tall and strong. He has short dark hair and brown eyes. He has a small beard. Dan is very funny and friendly, but he is a bit shy with new people. He looks like his father. He loves cooking and playing football. I like him a lot.
Yes, I'm looking for a black jacket.
I'm a medium. Can I try this one on?
Of course. The fitting room is over there.
It's nice. How much is it?

Hello Tom, it's Ana. What are you doing? I'm not working today. I'm at home. I'm cooking dinner and my brother is watching TV. It's raining now, so we aren't going out. I usually go out on Fridays, but today is different. Are you free? Come and eat with us!
What is the weather like on Saturday?
It is going to be sunny and warm.
Great! Are you going to play football?
Yes, I am. And you? What are you going to do?
I'm going to go to the park with my sister.
Nice! Is it going to rain on Sunday?
No, it isn't. It is going to be cloudy.
It is going to rain tomorrow
It is cold in the winter
I am going to study tonight

My name is Carlos. I am 30 years old and I am from Brazil. I live in a small apartment in New York. There are two rooms and a kitchen. I work in a restaurant every day from nine to five. I usually have lunch at noon. At the weekend, I like walking in the park and cooking for my friends. Today it is sunny, so I am going to play football with them. I love my new city, but I miss my family.
Hello! I'm Carlos. I live in the apartment next to yours.
Nice to meet you, Carlos. I'm Julia. Where are you from?
I'm from Chicago. Do you work near here?
Yes, I work in a restaurant on Oak Street.
Great! Can you cook Brazilian food?
Yes, I can. Are you free on Saturday? I'm going to cook for my friends.
Hi Maria! How was your weekend?
It was great. I was at a party on Saturday.
Yes, it was. The music was amazing and the people were very nice.
Some of them were. And you? Where were you?
I was at home. It was a boring weekend, but I was tired.
We were at home last night

Last Saturday, I woke up early. I cleaned my apartment and I cooked lunch. After lunch, I called my mother and we talked for an hour. Then I visited my friend Lara. We watched a movie and we laughed a lot. I didn't study, and I didn't go to the gym. At night, I was very tired, so I stayed at home and listened to music.

Yesterday I took the bus to work. I sat next to a woman, and I found a wallet on the seat. I gave it to the driver. He told me, "Thank you!" The woman saw it and said, "That is my wallet!" She was very happy. She bought me a coffee and we talked for ten minutes. I came to work late, but my boss understood. It was a great day.
I went to the park yesterday
He saw his friends last night
You look tired, Ben. What happened?
I woke up late, so I missed the bus.
Oh no! What did you do?
First, I called a taxi. Then I waited for twenty minutes.
No, I didn't. I arrived late to the meeting. Luckily, my boss was kind.
First, I woke up and then I had breakfast
I used to play football every day
Hi Chris! I called you at nine, but you didn't answer.
Sorry! I was taking a shower.
And at ten? I called again.
At ten I was watching a movie with my brother.
We were watching a comedy. It was very funny!
I was watching TV at nine

It was a busy morning and I was waiting for the bus. While I was reading a message on my phone, a stranger took my wallet. I noticed it when I wanted to pay. I ran after him, but he was too fast. Luckily, a police officer was standing at the corner. He stopped the man and I got my wallet back. After that, I was very careful with my bag.
I was cooking when the phone rang
While she was walking, it started to rain
I saw an accident while I was walking
I'm hungry. There isn't any food at home.
Don't worry. I'll make a sandwich for you.
Thanks! Will you also make some coffee?
Sure. I think we'll have a nice evening.
Tomorrow I'm going to visit my grandmother. Do you want to come?
Yes, I'll come with you. I'll bring some flowers.
Look at the clouds! It's going to rain

Rio and São Paulo are two of the biggest cities in Brazil. São Paulo is bigger than Rio, but Rio is more famous for its beaches. In São Paulo, life is faster and the traffic is worse. In Rio, the weather is hotter, and the people are as friendly as in any other city. My favorite city is Rio, because it is the most beautiful place I know. For work, São Paulo is better.
This bag is cheaper than that one
She is the tallest in the class
This is the best day of my life
He is as tall as his father
Excuse me, I need some flour and sugar. How much is a bag of flour?
Two dollars. How many bags do you want?
Just one. Do you have any eggs?
Yes, but there are only a few left.
That's enough. I need six eggs and a little salt.
How many bottles of water do you want
I have a headache every day and I feel tired.
How many hours do you sleep?
Only five. I have to work late every night.
You should sleep at least seven hours. And you shouldn't drink coffee at night.
Do I have to take medicine?
No, you don't have to. But you must rest.
Excuse me, could I sit here?
Of course. The seat is free.
Thanks. Could you also help me with my bag? It's very heavy.
My phone might die soon. May I borrow your charger?
I'm sorry, I don't have one. Maybe the conductor has one.
Could you open the window, please

I love traveling. I have visited five countries: Argentina, Chile, the United States, Portugal and Japan. I have been to Japan twice, and I have eaten sushi in Tokyo. I have never been to Africa, but I would like to go. My brother has been to Egypt and he has seen the pyramids. He has gone to Canada this month, so he isn't here now. Have you ever traveled abroad?
Have you ever been to Brazil
Have you seen my keys, Lucy? I can't find them.
No, I haven't. Have you looked in your bag?
Yes, I have. I've already searched everywhere.
Hmm. Have you checked your jacket yet?
Not yet. Wait… here they are! I've just found them.
Great! Now we can go. The bus has just arrived.
I have already finished my homework

My name is Paul. I moved to this city in 2018, so I have lived here for about six years. I have worked at the same company since 2019. My colleague Sam has been my friend since the first day. I have known my neighbor for three years, and we have played football together every Sunday since last spring. I love this city, but I haven't been back to my hometown since last Christmas.
I have lived here for five years
How long have you lived here
I have known him for ten years
Have you worked in sales before?
Yes, I have. I have worked in sales for four years.
What did you do at your last job?
I managed a small team and I sold cars. Last year, I sold more than two hundred.
The company closed in March, so I have been looking for a new job since then.
This is the first time I have flown
Tom, wake up! It's seven o'clock.
No, get up now! I'll pick you up at eight.
OK, OK. I'm looking for my keys. Have you seen them?
Look on the table. And turn off the TV, please.
I'll turn it off. Don't give up on me!

Hi Ana! I'm looking forward to seeing you next week. We haven't caught up for months. I grew up in a small town, but now I live in a big city. I get along with my neighbors, and we hang out on weekends. I signed up for a gym because I want to work out more. I'm also cutting down on sugar. Last week my car broke down, so I took the bus. Call me back when you can!
I'm looking forward to seeing you
Good evening. Do you have a reservation?
Yes, I have a reservation under the name Silva.
A single room for three nights. Is that correct?
Yes, it is. It's from seven to ten. Here is your key card.
Thank you. Could you tell me where the station is? If I have time, I will visit the museum tomorrow.
If it rains, we will stay at the hotel
Could you tell me where the station is
I have a sore throat and a cough. I also have a fever.
How long have you felt like this?
For three days. My head hurts, too.
You have a cold. Take this medicine twice a day, drink a lot of water and get some rest.
Thank you, doctor. Will I be OK by the weekend?
Yes, I think you will. If you aren't better, come back.
I have a sore throat and a cough
Take this medicine twice a day

Last summer, I went to Canada for the first time. I had never been abroad before, so I was very nervous. I arrived in Toronto on a rainy Monday, and my luggage was lost at the airport. Luckily, the airline found it two days later. I stayed with a friend who has lived there for ten years. We visited the CN Tower, ate a lot of good food and took a train to Niagara Falls. The falls were bigger than I expected. If I have enough money next year, I will go back. I think it is the most beautiful country I have ever visited.
What are you going to do this weekend, Ben?
I'm not sure. If it is sunny, I will go to the beach. And you?
I have to study because I have an exam on Monday. I haven't finished yet.
You should take a break. Last weekend, you studied all day!
You're right. Maybe I will go with you on Sunday.
Great! I'll pick you up at nine.
If it rains, I will stay at home
She was cooking when the phone rang
I have never been to Canada
Ben! I haven't seen you for ages. What have you been doing?
I've been working a lot. I have been learning English for six months.
Really? How long have you been studying every day?
About an hour a day. I have finished two books so far.
That's great! You look tired, though.
I know. I've been sleeping badly lately.
I have been studying for two hours
How long have you been waiting
It has been raining all day

Last Friday, I woke up early because I had an important meeting. I took a shower, had breakfast and left home at seven. By the time I arrived at the office, the doors were closed. I had been waiting for ten minutes when my boss called. He said that the meeting had been on Thursday! I had made a mistake. I had read the wrong date in the email. I laughed, went home and had a quiet day. Now I always check the calendar twice.
When I arrived, the film had started
By the time we arrived, they had gone
Chris, I have a problem. I got a job offer in another city, but I don't want to leave my friends.
What would you do if you didn't have to decide today?
I would take the job. I wish I had more time to think.
If I were you, I would talk to the company and ask for one more week.
That's a good idea. If they said yes, I would feel much better.
And you can visit your friends often. It wouldn't be so difficult.
If I won the lottery, I would travel the world
If I were you, I would call him
I wish I had more time

Last year, I didn't apply for a job at a big company because I thought I wasn't good enough. Yesterday, I found out that they hired a friend of mine, and she is not more qualified than I am. I wish I had applied! If I had tried, I might have got the job. I should have believed in myself. But I can't change the past. Now I send my CV to at least two companies every week. If I hadn't missed that chance, I wouldn't be so determined today.
If I had studied, I would have passed
I wish I had studied more

Coffee is grown in many countries, and Brazil is the largest producer in the world. First, the coffee beans are picked by hand or by machine. Then they are washed and dried in the sun. After that, they are sent to factories, where they are roasted and packed. Finally, the coffee is sold in shops and supermarkets all over the world. In Brazil, coffee has been grown since the 18th century, and it will be produced for many more years.
Hello, I'm calling about an order. It hasn't been delivered yet.
I'm sorry. When was it ordered?
Ten days ago. And the last time I called, I was told it would be sent in two days.
Let me check. Yes, I see. The wrong address was entered.
Can it be fixed today? I'd like to have it delivered tomorrow.
Yes, it will be sent today, and you will receive a refund for the shipping.
I can't remember the word. It's a thing that you use to open a bottle.
Yes! And what's the word for a person who fixes cars?
A mechanic. And a place where you buy medicine is a pharmacy.
Great! My English is better when I use words that describe things.
Exactly. That's a strategy that many learners use.
The man who lives next door is a doctor
This is the city where I was born
The book that I read was great
The girl whose bag was stolen is crying
my sister, who lives in Rio
my boss, whose name is Tom

I have two brothers. My older brother, who lives in Rio, is a doctor. He works in a hospital that is near the beach, which is why he loves his job. My younger brother, whose name is Tom, is a student. The girl sitting next to him in class is his girlfriend. The book written by their teacher is very difficult, which worries them. I am proud of both brothers, who work hard every day.
My brother, who lives in Rio, is a doctor
He passed the exam, which surprised everyone
The man standing there is my uncle
The book written by her is famous
Ben, Maria called while you were out.
She said she was sorry, but she couldn't come to the meeting.
She told me that her son was sick, and she promised to send the report by email.
OK. Did she say she would call again?
Yes, she said she would call tomorrow.
He told me he would call
She promised to send the report
He said he had gone home

Yesterday I called a hotel to book a room. The receptionist asked me what dates I needed and how many people were coming. I told her that we would arrive on Friday and that we were three people. She asked if we wanted breakfast, and I said yes. I asked her whether there was parking, and she told me that it was free. Before I hung up, she reminded me to bring my passport and asked me not to arrive after ten p.m.
He told me not to be late
She asked if I was tired
How is your new life in New York, Carlos?
It's great, but I'm still getting used to living here.
I'm not used to eating dinner so early. In Brazil, I used to eat at nine.
You'll get used to it. Don't forget to try the pizza near my office!
I remember seeing it. I'm looking forward to trying it.

I am very excited about my new job. I'm good at working with people, and I'm interested in learning new things. I was afraid of changing companies, but I believe in taking risks. My boss is proud of my work, and she depends on me to solve problems. I'm thinking about taking an English course because I need to talk to clients. There is only one problem with the job: the commute is long, so I listen to music on the bus.
I listen to music every day
